description.zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成，由控制台创建后获取。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application, which is a 6-character string of lowercase letters and digits. You can obtain this identifier from the console after creating the application.

description.zh: 直播唯一标识，由调用CreateLiveRoom返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the live stream, returned by calling CreateLiveRoom.
The user ID of the operator.
